keys.title: API Keys & Permissions
keys.desc: Manage API keys for calling gateway models. Master keys have full access; sub keys allow fine-grained control over bound upstream models.
keys.keyCreated: Key created. Save it now (shown only once).
keys.saveSubkeyPrompt: Please copy and save your sub key
keys.subkeyWarning: This key is named "{name}". For security, this plaintext key is shown only once. Cannot be recovered after refresh or close.
keys.recordedClose: I've saved it, close this card
keys.masterKeyDesc: Master key can call all visible models. Plaintext shown only at creation.
keys.emptySubkeys: No sub keys. Create one to configure model bindings.
keys.noSubkeySelectedDesc: Select a sub key on the left to configure its model bindings.
keys.noBindings: No bindings. This sub key cannot call any gateway model.
keys.selectModelPlaceholder: + Select an upstream model to bind...
keys.bindHint: Once bound, clients with this sub key can call the selected upstream models.

models.title: My Models
models.desc: Define models on your providers (public name + upstream real name). These can be bound to sub keys or used in Chat.
models.needProvider: Please add at least one Provider in "My Providers" first.

providers.title: My Providers
providers.desc: Add your own upstream providers (base_url + key). Keys are encrypted at rest, callable only by you.

templates.title: Prompt Templates
templates.desc: Reusable prompt templates and agents. Pick one to fill variables and start a chat.

memory.desc: User profile and preferences stored across sessions. Automatically injected into context when the model generates replies for a personalized experience.
memory.empty: No memories yet. Add your first one in the form on the right.
memory.scopePreferenceOpt: preference (user prefs - injected into preference slot, max 400 chars)
memory.scopeProjectOpt: project (in-progress items - semantic recall, expires after 1 week unused)
memory.contentPlaceholder: e.g. I prefer concise answers, line-break long formulas, and reply in Chinese.
memory.guide1: 1. preference: store model tone/style/language prefs. Always injected at the top of context.
memory.guide2: 2. profile: record job, tech stack and other identity facts. Auto-injected as background.
memory.guide3: 3. project: record projects, tasks, plans in progress. Semantically recalled by current topic, expires after 1 week unused.

cards.title: Instruction Cards
cards.desc: Reusable instruction snippets, injected when selected in chat. Type /trigger or click a card.
cards.empty: No instruction cards yet. Create your first one.
cards.builtinReadonly: Built-in cards are read-only (managed by admin)
cards.fieldsRequired: Trigger, title, and content are required
cards.contentPlaceholder: You are a senior translator. Translate user input between Chinese and English...

knowledge.desc: Manage knowledge bases, ingest files, and mount them for retrieval in chat.

webSearch.desc: Configure the global search order and external providers. Chat keeps one web toggle and searches in this order when needed.
webSearch.orderDesc: Drag to set priority. Unavailable backends are skipped automatically.
webSearch.providersDesc: Manage Tavily, Bocha, Zhipu, and public SearXNG credentials.
webSearch.searchModelPlaceholder: Select GPT, Claude, Gemini, or Grok
webSearch.hint_tavily: Requires an API key from the Tavily dashboard.
webSearch.hint_bocha: Requires an API key from the Bocha platform.
webSearch.hint_zhipu: Requires a BigModel API key; model is optional (default glm-4-plus).
webSearch.hint_searxng: Must be a public HTTP/HTTPS instance. Private and local services are rejected.
webSearch.apiKeyKeepPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep the configured key
webSearch.empty: No provider configured yet. Add one on the right.
webSearch.guide1: When web access is enabled, the model decides whether search is needed.
webSearch.guide2: Failed backends fall through in global priority order.

users.title: User Management
users.desc: View and manage all registered users; adjust roles and enabled status.
users.footerNote: New users are typically synced on first Better Auth login, or created by the seed script.

operations.title: Operations
operations.desc: Real-time system status, dependency health, active connections and upstream provider performance.

settings.desc: Manage system-level model configuration for embedding, web search, title generation, and other auxiliary tasks. Changes take effect immediately after saving.
settings.basicDesc: Configure the User-Agent sent when forwarding upstream. Defaults to Nekusora/<version> when unset. Probe requests follow the chat UA. Takes effect immediately after saving.
settings.chatUaHint: Used by chat workspace forwarding + auxiliary tasks (title/summary/memory) + probe requests. Leave empty to use the default.
settings.gatewayUaHint: Used by the API gateway (/v1) forwarding. Leave empty to use the default.
settings.configDesc: Configure models for embedding and background AI tasks. Changes take effect immediately.
settings.embeddingHint: Dimension must be 1024 (e.g. bge-m3, via an OpenAI-compatible endpoint such as SiliconFlow). Requires an openai-protocol provider configured in Global Providers.
settings.titleTaskHint: Generates conversation titles in the background. Follows the current chat model when empty and never blocks response completion.
settings.configNoProviders: No enabled providers. Add one in Global Providers first.
settings.compactTaskHint: Used for long-conversation context compaction. Automatically selects an available public model when empty.
settings.mem0LlmHint: Used by mem0 for memory extraction and consolidation through Nekosora's unified model routing. Follows the title model when empty.

models.title: Global Models
models.desc: Manage global public models and routes available to all users.

providers.title: Global Providers
providers.desc: Manage global upstream providers and credentials used by model routing.

templates.title: Global Prompt Templates
templates.desc: View and manage all templates (builtin / shared / private); toggle and delete.
templates.empty: No templates. Run pnpm tsx scripts/seed-templates.ts to seed built-in templates.

usage.title: Usage Statistics
usage.desc: Query gateway call usage and error requests; filter by time, user, model and more. Admins see their own usage by default and can clear to view all users or a specific user.

overview.title: Admin Overview
overview.desc: Configure upstream providers, public models, routing load balancing and user authorization. Monitor the high-availability gateway.
overview.linkProvidersDesc: Add, configure or toggle global upstream AI providers
overview.linkModelsDesc: Configure public models and multi-provider failover weights
overview.linkUsersDesc: View platform users, enable or disable API accounts
overview.linkUsageDesc: View gateway call logs, token consumption and latency details
overview.gatewayHint: Gateway calls: API base URL is <base>/v1</base>, API keys are managed in <link>Dashboard</link>.

outputModes.desc: Preset session-level output modes that guide the model to answer in a specific format/style (e.g. an HTML mode makes the model emit renderable HTML). Users pick one in the chat toolbar.
outputModes.promptPlaceholder: systemPrompt instruction. E.g. for an HTML mode: Respond with a single self-contained HTML document, all styles inlined in a style tag, no external resources, wrapped in an html code fence.
outputModes.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete "{name}"?
outputModes.deleteWarning: This action is irreversible and will permanently delete this output mode from the database.

renderStyles.desc: Preset session-level Markdown render styles. Pure presentation-layer beautification, does not affect model output. Users pick one in the chat toolbar and AI answers render with the chosen style.
renderStyles.cssClassHint: Becomes the DOM class rs-your-slug and the CSS selector prefix. Cannot be changed for built-in styles.
renderStyles.cssPlaceholder: CSS text. Start selectors with .rs-your-slug .nekusora-md, e.g. .rs-xxx .nekusora-md h2 to target and style headings.
renderStyles.cssHint: CSS is injected into the chat page as-is and applies to AI answers. Do not include malicious content. Target elements via streamdown's data-streamdown attributes.
renderStyles.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete "{name}"?
renderStyles.deleteWarning: This action is irreversible. Conversations using this style will fall back to the default rendering.
